findings.title: Unsafe checkouts pass the credential test
findings.description: `persistedCredentials` takes the option indentation from the first raw line after `with:`, even when that line is a YAML comment, and can mistake text inside a block scalar for the option. A pinned checkout whose `ssh-known-hosts` string contains `persist-credentials: false` can therefore omit the actual option while this test passes and checkout retains its default credential behavior.

evidence.explanation: The parser collects raw lines, derives `indent` from `block[0]`, and counts any matching line at that indentation. For example, under a pinned checkout, `with:` followed by an eight-space-indented comment, a six-space-indented `ssh-known-hosts: |-`, and an eight-space-indented `persist-credentials: false` passes these checks; YAML treats the last line as string content, not as an input. The repository's recorded checkout logs establish that omitting the input leaves credential persistence enabled.

findings.title: Escaped checkouts evade the new test
findings.description: `persistedCredentials` only examines lines containing the literal text `actions/checkout`, so it skips a double-quoted `uses` value that spells part of the action name with a YAML Unicode escape. For example, `uses: "actions/\u0063heckout@…"` resolves to checkout but produces no credential problem when the option is absent; the separate action-pin check rejects that quoted spelling today.

evidence.explanation: The literal-only `MENTION` check returns before validating the step or its inputs. The existing pin checker recognizes escaped YAML syntax as a concern and rejects quoted action values, which limits this defect to the new credential check while that independent guard remains in place.

findings.title: Ticket-link check fails on this pull request
findings.description: The new BACKLOG.md row for T-035 has the status `planned`, but `checkPrTicket` in `scripts/pr-ticket-check.ts` requires exactly `done (PR <n>)` for any ticket named in the PR title or closed by the PR. As long as the row says `planned`, the required `ticket-link` workflow reports a problem for T-035, which blocks acceptance criterion 5 (`ticket-link` runs green on the pull request).

location.code_snippet: +| T-035 | Every `actions/checkout` step sets `persist-credentials: false`, with a test that fails on a checkout step without it (Arnica, 4 Medium findings) | 16 Nov 23 (Day 16, inside the approval guard) | planned |

evidence.explanation: `claimedTickets` counts a ticket from the title or from a closing issue as claimed unless its single row is already `done (PR m)` for some other PR. `checkPrTicket` then compares the row's status with `done (PR ${number})` and reports a mismatch. Here the row says `planned`, so the ticket-link job that `ticket-link.yml` runs on every PR update reports a problem for T-035.
